title: Asian Chicken or Turkey Garden Salad with Crispy Noodles, Chicken and/or Turkey, Lettuce, Fruit, Nuts, Crispy Noodles (No Dressing)

content.title: About
content.content: The Asian chicken or turkey garden salad with crispy noodles combines tender pieces of chicken or turkey, crunchy noodles, fresh lettuce, juicy fruit (such as apple or pineapple) and nuts (often cashews or almonds). It is served without dressing, allowing each person to add their preferred sauce.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is inspired by Asian cuisine, where sweet‑savory combinations are common.
Crispy noodles are usually made from rice or wheat flour and deep‑fried until golden.
Fruit adds natural sweetness and vitamin C, which enhances iron absorption from the meat.
Nuts provide crunch and healthy fats typical of many Asian salads.
The salad is often offered in fast‑casual restaurants as a light lunch or snack.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey are excellent sources of high‑quality protein needed for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Poultry provides B3 and B6 vitamins that support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Vitamin C from fruit
items.content: Apples, pineapple or mango contribute vitamin C, boosting immunity and iron absorption.

items.title: Healthy fats from nuts
items.content: Nuts supply monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Fiber from lettuce
items.content: Leafy greens add dietary fiber, aiding digestion and promoting satiety.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: Nuts can trigger allergic reactions, up to anaphylaxis, in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium in fried noodles
items.content: Crispy noodles often contain added salt, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Sugar content in fruit
items.content: A generous amount of fruit raises the natural sugar load, which diabetics should monitor.

items.title: Meat safety
items.content: When buying pre‑made salad, ensure the chicken/turkey has been properly cooked to avoid food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the salad straight from the container. If desired, drizzle soy sauce, ginger dressing, or a light lime‑honey vinaigrette. Pairs well with tea or a crisp white wine.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C and consume within 24 hours. Longer storage may cause noodles to lose crunch and lettuce to wilt.
